description: Liliane Magnavaca de Paula and collaborators publish simulated office-building configurations for Orlando, Florida, in ASHRAE climate zone 2A. The October 2025 deposit combines Revit analytical models with Autodesk Insight energy simulations and supplies Excel and Weka ARFF tables under CC BY 4.0, with free access. Inputs vary geometry, envelope, systems and operating assumptions; outputs include energy-use intensity and operational energy. The subsequently published Applied Sciences paper describes 210 parametric simulations spanning base, generalisation and stress-test cases. These tables can benchmark surrogate models for early building-design simulations. They represent constructed alternatives, not measured buildings, and results should not be transferred directly to other climates or building types. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this dataset. Exact table dimensions, uncertainty and source-model completeness were not independently checked. Publication status was refreshed from the publisher and Crossref.
